status: Plan only. User approved planning, not provisioning, spending or routing changes.
scope: Anstoss only; no Renuir resources or shared-account settings

targetMapping.develop: Anstoss staging, only after full quality checks
targetMapping.prod: Existing Anstoss production, only after verified staging acceptance and explicit promotion approval
targetMapping.releaseIdentity: Record exact tested git SHA, migrations, deployment ID, runtime version and QA report references

proposedIsolation: Create an empty EU staging environment in the existing Anstoss project only after cost approval; do not blindly duplicate production variables or every existing service.
Provision a separate staging API and PostgreSQL database with synthetic 16+ test accounts. Never copy live user data or point staging at the production database.
Use separate Redis credentials and namespace for socket routing, rate limits, cache and background work. Verify separation before booting workers.
Use separate upload storage credentials and bucket; block access to production media. Quote incremental storage costs before setup.
Use separate session-signing and encryption keys; staging sessions must not authenticate to production or vice versa.
Email and push delivery must be restricted to explicitly approved QA recipients/devices. Never import production push tokens.
Use sandbox billing and allowlisted QA clubs only. Never attach production subscription grants or real customer payment data.
Keep social login disabled until revocation, interrupted-grant cleanup and real provider tests pass. Configure only Anstoss OAuth clients and redirect targets.
Use a separate staging API domain and app configuration; do not change the production app URL or publish an OTA to existing users.
Serve admin/website QA against staging explicitly. Keep scraper and unrelated or legacy database services out of the initial staging footprint unless a test needs them.
sequenceAfterApproval: Review exact resource inventory, EU region, incremental monthly estimate and user-approved budget before provisioning.
Provision isolated resources and synthetic data with outbound delivery blocked initially.
Validate database, Redis, storage, session and provider isolation with negative cross-environment tests.
Create environment-scoped deployment credentials; inspect exact project, service and environment IDs before changing GitHub development secrets.

Require successful quality checks, branch-head freshness and an environment approval gate before deployment. Verify repository-plan support for required reviewers; otherwise use an explicit manual approval workflow.
Deploy a pinned candidate SHA to staging, then verify migration completion, deployment SUCCESS and HTTP health.
Run all persona journeys and adversarial checks on staging, including permission denial, retries, reconnects, account deletion and billing expiry/replacement.
Run actual iPhone locked-screen notification and real Apple/Google/provider sandbox tests; obtain a physical Android test device before claiming Android push readiness.
Only after all launch gates pass, request approval for production promotion and any necessary native/store build. No prod push before that approval.
Verify production target and recoverable deployment/database backups, promote only tested code, and observe health and error rates. Never roll back by destructively reversing migrations.

costApproval.estimatePending: Inspect existing plan allowance and size API, PostgreSQL, Redis and storage. No fixed total can be promised without workload measurements.
controls: Small initial resource limits and a single staging API replica; document what load they support.
Use scheduled QA periods if lower cost is necessary; keep staging running during reminder/retry timing tests.
Alerts and spending controls must be scoped to Anstoss. Do not set workspace-wide caps that could interrupt Renuir.
Do not enable automatic paid PR environments or upgrade a shared billing plan.

localChangesPreparedNotDeployed: Deploy API jobs now depend on the reusable complete Quality Gates workflow.
